rule: Receipt visibility tokens are opaque and never expose backend-native identifiers or topology.

assertions: No rejected token appears in a write receipt, query result, provenance envelope, model channel, or principal channel.
The engine treats an acceptable token as an uninterpreted value scoped to the issuing component.
expected.gap: RFC §7 mandates opacity but does not define a token grammar, entropy/length requirements, encryption, allowed prefix, scoping, rotation, or an objective test for whether an encoded token exposes a native identifier. The first case is not a mandated token format.
